notes.title: Beta Version 0.9.5 released!
notes.content:
List of changes/bugfixes were made to the game in this update! See below for a summary:

[list]
[*]Added all new character art! This includes new expressions for each character.
[*]Added short version of the game - when starting a game you can now select a condescended version of the story. The situations and puzzles remain untouched, the character conversations are simple shortened and summarized. Story was also tweaked.
[*]Fixed miscellaneous puzzles that had multiple solutions. Modified a few puzzles that now make more sense with the story.
[*]​Fixed Sound FX setting bug that was causing it to not save and load properly. Changing the Sound FX should now properly save and apply.
[*]​Fixed UI scaling for certain menus, text scaling, and made the textbox less transparent, making it easier to read.
[*]​Fixed spelling mistakes throughout story
[*]​Fixed miscellaneous bugs, such as black backgrounds and music not properly changing.
[/list]

More updates to come as we finalize the Beta!
